I can't answer all your questions but my health is quiet shit so I know this: when I get to a new doctor they ask me to sign a form and I'm allowing them to get my information from a certain doctor. And all my doctors report back to my GP. So a persons GP would have all the information in someone's health. But if you want to have your medical record you would probably have to contact all the specialists because the don't send the full report to the GP. 

My aunt had some problems this summer so they needed information on what happened during a surgery in the 70's and the hospital still had the record ( how ever they had to look for it)
